title: Area 51
description: HTML-forward card-game research: frozen object, declared rule, playable experiment, reproducible local receipt, exact result, then paper.

foundation.title: The Line Game | Surprise Is Not Meaning
foundation.licenseAuthority: The archived Zenodo record is authoritative for the deposited foundation and its license.

fixedObject.sourceRole: Supplied stored approximation to the first zeta-zero ordinate; transported by the codec, not calculated or independently certified by it.

declaredRepresentations.meaning: ordinary card identity and frozen position
user-authored symbol and meaning under a versioned Memory 51 mapping

representationBoundary: These meanings are declared maps or conventions. No card is claimed to possess a unique intrinsic psychological, physical, financial, or number-theoretic meaning.

objects.name: Invariant
objects.question: What does the exact card order carry, and what changes after one same-profile swap?

objects.name: Telescope 51
objects.question: What can a declared observation rule see and recover?

objects.name: Memory 51
objects.question: Can a user learn a versioned card-to-symbol correspondence in both directions?

objects.name: Blackjack 51
objects.question: Which distinctions survive contextual value rules, priced odds, and chosen observations?

objects.name: Prospect 51
objects.question: Which distinctions survive unordered poker scoring and an ordered archive key?

objects.name: 51 SEDAPS
objects.question: How much extra ledger is needed to recover a past when a deterministic forward rule has several legal predecessors?

objects.name: 51 Twins
objects.question: When two runs obey the same rule for a long time, which gate separates them, and how late?

supports: exact decoding under the declared codec
finite equality or difference of declared projections
complete finite census under a frozen rule
doesNotSupport: a newly calculated or newly certified zero

creditBoundary: Credits are designed game rewards and are not bits, entropy, intelligence, proof of learning, cash, or a scarce asset.

runningLabelBoundary.relation: For the published fixture, the card rule determines the running state and turn n; n selects the supplied stored label y_n and the ledger records both original and one-swap hand counts.
runningLabelBoundary.notClaimed: The cards do not generate y_n, supply a recurrence for y_(n+1), calculate an unobserved zero, or make y_n part of the card transition.

blackjackInformationMarket.visibleOddsModel: Uniform over card identities not visible to the player at the current decision state.
blackjackInformationMarket.separation: Buying odds exposes the safe/bust distribution but not the next card. The forecast stake and exact-card observation are separate transactions and ledgers.

dataPolicy: Local exports only in public Alpha; no automatic transmission or passive-traffic inference.

citation.instruction: Cite Jeffery Lyn Huckstead, the exact Area 51 page and rule version used, its canonical URL, and the v7.2 foundation DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22851517 whenever a summary or claim relies on this work.

economy.prospect_scope: Same browser-local bank; no global jackpot or cash value.
